note: Pretends to be USCIS and asks a gift-card fee to verify work authorization.
text:
OFFICIAL NOTICE from USCIS Student Employment Unit

Your internship with Harborview Tech requires work authorization verification. Pay the $180 processing fee by gift card within 24 hours or your offer will be cancelled. Send the card codes to uscis.verification.unit@outlook.com.
